newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Technoplast plans London offer.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Technoplast plans London offer.

text.p: The Israeli plastics company Technoplast Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that it had signed an agreement to issue eight million ordinary shares in London.
The shares, which will be traded on the London Stock Exchange, will be priced at 1.25 sterling each, raising net proceeds of 8.8 million sterling, the company said in a statement.
It said the offer was fully underwritten but gave no further details. Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
The statement also said the company's managing director, Itamar Patishi, would be selling an additional 1.6 million ordinary shares he controls.

Technoplast, which is traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, is one of the largest manufacturers of moulded-plastic products in Israel. In the first nine months of 1996 it had sales of 8.77 million sterling.

In October, another Israeli plastics company, Plasson Ltd, cancelled a planned London share offering, which officials at the time blamed on market nervousness due to political tensions in the Middle East.
